sources.entry: AdventureLog - Travel tracker and trip planner. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: AdventureLog is a self-hosted, GPL-3.0 travel tracker and trip planner that maps visited and planned places, multi-day itineraries, and countries/regions/cities.
summary.what_it_does: AdventureLog lets you pin locations on an interactive world map with visit dates, notes, photos, categories, tags, and multi-visit history. It supports multi-day trip itineraries with flights, lodging, checklists, links, and calendar views. A world travel section tracks countries, regions, and cities with stats and progress milestones. Trails and activities can carry GPX tracks, distance, and elevation data. Locations and itineraries can be shared through public links or with other users who are invited to edit together. The README also names integrations with Immich (photos), Strava and Endurain (activity import), Wanderer (trails), and Google Maps (geocoding), plus MFA, API keys, and social login.
use_cases: track places I have visited on a map
log travel history with photos and notes
attach GPX hiking routes to trips
how_to_run: curl -sSL | bash (one-container quick install; URL missing from the README text provided)
Or follow the Standard Deployment guide for Docker Compose
Requirements: Docker Engine + Compose v2, 2 GB RAM on first boot
Default login is admin / admin; change it after first sign-in
notable: Interactive world map with visited/planned filters and 2D and 3D views
Integrations with Immich, Strava, Endurain, Wanderer, and Google Maps
Multi-day itineraries with checklists and calendar views
Public link sharing and multi-user collaborative editing
Country, region, and city travel book with progress stats
caveats: Requires Docker and about 2 GB RAM on first boot
Default admin/admin credentials must be changed manually
Google Maps integration implies a Google API dependency for geocoding
